description.value: MR MIKES SteakhouseCasual is a Canadian chain with origins dating to 1960, now operating under a 'casual steakhouse' concept that emphasizes an unpretentious, welcoming atmosphere. The Kitimat location serves Canadian classics including premium steaks, Mikeburgers, pastas, salads, and shareable appetizers in a full sit-down setting. For touring cyclists passing through Kitimat, it offers a substantial hot meal with both dine-in and takeout options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for the Kitimat MR MIKES location confirms the address (525 Mountainview Square, Kitimat, BC V8C 2N1), phone (778-631-2391), and that the business is actively operating with dine-in, takeout, and delivery options. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via the 'Order for Takeout' call-to-action on the location page. No evidence is available in the website content for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or most other amenity fields, so those are set to null per the evidence-only rule.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (Mo-Th, Su 11:30-22:00; Fr-Sa 11:30-23:00) differs from website hours (Mon-Thu, Sun 11:00am-10:00pm; Fri-Sat 11:00am-11:00pm) — both start time and close time differ. OSM data may be stale.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible full-service restaurant confirmed open via website with current hours and online ordering. A practical meal stop for touring cyclists in Kitimat.
